episodes.title: 34. The spiritual, religious & internet cults podcast. This epi might trigger you.
episodes.description:
WE'RE NOT HERE TO CALL ANYONE OUT !

We're here to call ourselves back in.

An honest conversation about what happens when we unknowingly hand our power away... and how to find our way back to ourselves.

This is an exploration of the spaces between guidance and dependency, wisdom and authority, community and conformity. And what it means to find your own way home in a world full of people telling you where to go.

In this triggering epi, we explore the cultish dynamics that can emerge anywhere - spiritual communities, religious spaces, online movements, self-help circles, government ideologies, wellness culture, and even our own minds.

This is not a callout of any specific person, teacher, organization, or belief system.

Rather, it's an eagle-eye view of what can happen when we stop thinking for ourselves and begin outsourcing our truth to someone else.

We talk about radical responsibility, personal sovereignty, discernment, and what it means to find your own way through an increasingly noisy world.

We also introduce the concept of Radical Happiness - the practice of creating a life that genuinely feels aligned, meaningful, and true to you, rather than following a prescribed path handed to you by someone else.

Yep... we coined that.™️

As the saying goes, "We are all just walking each other home."

But home is your home.

Not your teacher's.
Not your guru's.
Not your parents'.
Not society's.
Not the internet's.

You cannot die in someone else's grave.

You are here to live your own life.

This conversation is offered from a place of love, curiosity, and awareness NOT judgment. Because being human is complicated, influence is everywhere, and learning to trust ourselves may be one of the most important journeys we'll ever take.

If this episode challenges you, good.

Let's talk about it.

WE ADORE YOU HEHE.

xx,



~

episodes.title: 22. The Joe Dispenza experience: coherence, commitment and yes this is definitely a cult
episodes.description: "Sorry can't get to the phone right now I'm at Joe Dispenza..." In this epi Taylor shares how she found her way into daddy Joe Dispenza’s work and how it became one of the catalysts that changed her life. She spills the low down on attending three of his retreats, what actually happens in the rooms people love to speculate about, and how his teachings around coherence, meditation, and commitment reshaped her entire relationship to living life. We explore what it really means to take responsibility for your inner state, how the body responds when the mind changes (embodiment helloooo), and why consistency—not bypassing—is the work. Call it a cult? We call it devotion... And we want to be apart of this cult. This isn’t a sales pitch or blind praise. It’s a firsthand reflection on learning how to heal yourself, meet your edge, and stay committed to that higher frequency. Because no one is coming to save you - so you better buckle up and take ownership of your life. Taylor also gives a mini update on her life: what's brewing for her in the next few months and the intentions she's stepping into.
